justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces combine schematic outlined profile creatures with small abstract/geometric signs, including curving serpent-like forms and repeated marks. The major difference is that B is organized around a dominant standing human figure with surrounding symbols, while A is divided more into horizontal zones of animals and pattern without the same central human-icon scheme.
